messages:
Priya Rao: Customer Y pushed back on how burst carryover is calculated across reserved pools vs per-tenant quotas. They want deterministic monthly billing and an example of worst-case SLA burn.

Ben Torres: We should publish the exact carryover formula and an example ledger. Current idea: carryover_tokens = min(allocated_pool_burst, tenant_unused_quota * carryover_pct). That makes it transparent.

Anya Kuznetsova: For SLA burn, we need a simulator that replays a 7-day spike and shows p95 latency, token debt, and billing delta. QA can run this against reserve/pool config.

Priya Rao: Good. Add a short policy for smoothing spikes: if burst debt > X tokens, apply smoothing windows (60s buckets) and promote prewarm units automatically if tenant is enterprise.

Ben Torres: Decision point: auto-prewarm vs notify-only. Ops prefers notify-only to avoid cost surprises; sales/legal prefer opt-in auto-prewarm for higher-tier customers. Recommend: auto-prewarm for enterprise Tiers 3+, notify + 1-click prewarm for others.

Anya Kuznetsova: We also need to record metric `burst.carryover_debt` and `billing.carryover_adjustment`. Add tags: `pool.id`, `tenant.tier`, `smoothing.applied`.

Priya Rao: Can we add a CSV sample in the migration report that shows monthly worst-case charges? Sales asked for a single-row example per customer.

Ben Torres: Example CSV header: tenant,month,base_commit,carryover_used,carryover_charge,prewarm_charge,total_charge

Anya Kuznetsova: For the roadmap, include these launch gates: 1) public formula and examples; 2) simulator + two customer pilots; 3) billing reconciliation signed off by finance; 4) opt-in auto-prewarm policy documented; 5) SRE degrade policy updated.

Priya Rao: Ops-bot, can you run a 7-day spike sim on reserved-pool-eu-central-1-b with carryover_pct=0.2 and smoothing window=60s?

ops-bot: simulation queued for reserved-pool-eu-central-1-b (carryover_pct=0.2, smoothing=60s). ETA 12m. :robot_face:

Carlos M.: Also flagging: contracts team requires a short paragraph for T&Cs about carryover rounding and proration. Legal wants language before GA.

Ben Torres: Implementation plan: API endpoints `GET /migration/dry-run?tenant=...` and `POST /prewarm` with idempotency key. Add `--explain` CLI flag to show line-by-line accounting.

Anya Kuznetsova: QA checklist: simulate mixed-tenancy bursts, long-lived sessions, KV pinning behavior, and billing reconciliation at month boundary. Canary rollout: 0.5% traffic -> 5% -> 20% -> 100%, each stage 48h.

Priya Rao: Next steps: Ben to draft public formula + CSV example by Wed. Anya to wire simulator tests and canary plan. Carlos to coordinate contracts paragraph. Sync Thurs 11am to review GA checklist.

ops-bot: simulation complete. Peak carryover debt=4.2M tokens, peak p95 latency +32ms, smoothing prevented token debt spikes > 15%. No billing anomalies found in staging. :white_check_mark:
